commits 722f056 · 2c4400f · c4e190d · 65ca5c5

FX-79 PLANET SIZES — REAL DIAMETERS, TRUE-SCALE ACCURATE, OTHERS SMALLER ▲ index

commits c461999

Planet dot sizes now derive from real radiusKm data. True Scale is accurate against the Sun (Jupiter 0.10×). Proportional and Thematic were shrunk so Jupiter no longer dwarfs the scene — it was reading about 83% of the Sun and is now about 36%. The Moon is sized to its real 0.273× Earth ratio (it was a padded 0.333×). Every ratio is truth-locked (celestial-truth 86/86) so a silent edit fails the harness.

3 · Final Assessment — 12 Ascended Masters (111 words each)

Thoth (Data & Analytics)

The data spine is finally honest, because every planet size now traces to a cited diameter and a locked ratio rather than a convenient constant. The celestial-truth harness stands at eighty-six of eighty-six: true-scale Jupiter is exactly one tenth of the Sun, the Moon is zero point two seven three of Earth, and proportional Jupiter is held under forty-five percent of the Sun where it was eighty-three. Each number fails the harness if it drifts, so the fix cannot silently rot. My analytics ask is unchanged in spirit: keep disclosing provenance, and instrument which size mode operators actually choose, so the defaults are measured by evidence, never merely assumed by us.
